commands.notation: Sanitized actual command templates. devcontainer invokes the isolated official CLI package with Node; variables stand for disposable workspace and unique ownership label, not repository settings.
commands.exec: devcontainer exec --workspace-folder "$REFERENCE_WORKSPACE" --mount-workspace-git-root false --id-label "$OWNED_REFERENCE_LABEL" --default-user-env-probe none --oci-auth-hardening bash --noprofile --norc -c 'test "$(id -un)" = vscode && test "$REALM_REFERENCE" = authored-reference-only && test "$REALM_PROJECTION" = not-emitted-by-realm-10 && test -f .devcontainer/devcontainer.json && test -f reference.txt && printf "realm-reference-ok\n"'
commands.reopen: Repeat up with --expect-existing-container, then repeat exec; existing container identity retained.
commands.recreate: Remove only the container carrying the unique owned reference label; repeat identical up and exec; new container identity observed.

limitations: Authored image-only reference on one local Linux AMD64 engine; no Realm #10 projection was emitted.
Host requirements were interpreted as data; no machine allocation, GPU or port forwarding was tested.
No package signature or provenance verification is claimed for the reference CLI package.
Container recreation with identical configuration is not a Dockerfile rebuild or Codespaces rebuild.
This independent observation receipt is not consumed as authentication or qualification by the static boundary checker.
